2775.body:
"Casino 7s" has four of four top prizes left and is near the start of its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Everything here about "Casino 7s" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through November 6.
2775.headline: Tickets sold so far

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" has had no $30,000 top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Every line of Patriotic Payout's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2776.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

2779.body:
Only a small slice of the tickets for "Gnome for the Holidays" have been sold. The game is still new. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Everything here about "Gnome for the Holidays" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through November 6.
2779.headline: Early stage or late

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" just reached Texas stores with five top prizes of $100,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

The numbers for "Holiday Countdown" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2780.headline: First day on sale

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" has joined the Texas lineup at $10 with five top prizes of $250,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

If "The Perfect Gift" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2781.headline: A brand-new game to watch

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" just went on sale in Texas. The game has eight full prize levels with four top prizes of $1 million. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

The table below shows the full count for "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe", with every prize level included.
